source.author: Raymond Hettinger
source.summary: Fix stability in running_min and running_max

description: running_min/running_max use a monotonically-increasing/decreasing subsequence with a STRICT comparison (`<` / `>`), so when an equal-but-different-type value arrives (0 then 0.0 then Fraction(0)) the incumbent is dropped and the running min/max silently changes TYPE. min(x,y)/max(x,y) return the LEFT operand when x == y, so the window must keep the incumbent's type. The real fix uses `<=` / `>=`. This is the mathematically-subtle case in the suite. seed/mod.py is the verbatim pre-fix extracted standalone; seed/mod_fixed.py is the real fix.
